system.description:
You have learned to master the ancestral weapons of your people and can penetrate even the staunchest defenses.

Prerequisite: Gungan

Effect: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to an attack roll with an Atlatl or a Cesta, increase the die type by one step (From d6 to d8, or from d8 to d10).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
